messages:
Hannah Lee: Quick sync: noticed inconsistent terms between the Routes list and the in-product docs flyout. Users are confused when sharing links.
Ravi Patel: examples?
Hannah Lee: Flyout label: 'Open guidance'; console shows 'View docs'. Flyout refers to 'Variant' while the Routes table shows 'Serving variant'. Also the flyout permalink uses a fragment id ("#variant-panel") that doesn't match the canonical docs URL.
Clara Gomez: that mismatch caused a support ticket yesterday where a user pinned the wrong thing. small text but high friction.
Leo Park: Proposal: standardize to 'Model variant' in UI and 'Instance tier' for infra. Make the flyout 'Copy canonical link' that points to docs URL format: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/routes?routeId=<id>&section=variant
Ravi Patel: Docs: will add that canonical URL pattern and sample copy. I'll include aria-label recommendations for the button (e.g., aria-label="Open docs for this route").
Hannah Lee: accessibility: keyboard focus currently skips the flyout's 'Open guidance' anchor on desktop. Need tabindex + visible focus ring.
Leo Park: I'll file two small PRs: one to change the i18n keys for labels, one to make the anchor keyboard-focusable and add aria attributes. I'll run axe/VoiceOver checks.
Clara Gomez: Product will run a quick PM poll on the lexicon. If approved, we'll push the change across console strings and docs.
docs-bot: Draft KB: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/kb/permalinks-flyout-consistency (private)
Hannah Lee: Timeline: lexicon by EOD Mon, docs examples by Wed, UI PRs in this sprint. Drop any other mismatches (quota/limit wording, 'capacity' vs 'instance') into this thread and we'll batch them. :thumbsup:
